blocks.text: Yeh Unit 11 (Trigonometric Functions and their Graphs) ke poore unit se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, unit ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal mukhtasar qadmon mein hal kiya gaya hai.
11.1 Domains and Ranges of Sine and Cosine Functions

blocks.prompt:
1 Define the domain and the range of a function.
(Function ke domain aur range ki definition likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Domain: woh tamam inputs jo function qabool karta hai. Range: woh tamam outputs jo function deta hai. Maslan \(\sin\theta\): domain \(\mathbb{R}\), range \([-1, 1]\).

book_ref.quote: the set of all inputs that a function accepts

blocks.prompt:
2 Find the domain and range of \(y = \cos x\).
(\(y = \cos x\) ka domain aur range nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Har real angle ke liye unit circle par aik point, \(\cos x\) us ka \(x\)-coordinate: domain \(\mathbb{R}\). Unit circle par \(-1 \le x_0 \le 1\): range \([-1, 1]\).

book_ref.quote: Thus, the range of sine and cosine functions is

blocks.prompt:
3 Is \(3\sin\theta = 4\) possible for some real \(\theta\)? Give a reason.
(Kya kisi real \(\theta\) ke liye \(3\sin\theta = 4\) mumkin hai? Wajah dein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Is ke liye \(\sin\theta = \frac{4}{3} > 1\) chahiye, jabke sine ki range \([-1, 1]\) hai.

book_ref.quote: Use the range to spot impossible equations at once.

blocks.text: 11.1.1 Domains and Ranges of Tangent and Cotangent Functions

blocks.prompt:
4 Find the domain and range of \(\tan\theta\).
(\(\tan\theta\) ka domain aur range nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: A fraction has no value when its denominator is

blocks.prompt:
5 Find the domain and range of \(\cot\theta\).
(\(\cot\theta\) ka domain aur range nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: For cotangent the denominator is

blocks.prompt:
6 Find all \(\theta\) in \([0, 2\pi]\) where \(\cot\theta\) is undefined and all where \(\tan\theta\) is undefined.
(\([0, 2\pi]\) mein woh tamam \(\theta\) nikalein jahan \(\cot\theta\) undefined hai, aur jahan \(\tan\theta\) undefined hai.)

book_ref.quote: Swapping the two lists: tangent fails on the

blocks.text: 11.1.2 Domains and Ranges of Secant Function

blocks.prompt:
7 Find the domain and range of \(y = \sec x\).
(\(y = \sec x\) ka domain aur range nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: So secant and tangent have the same domain.

blocks.prompt:
8 Is \(\sec\theta = \frac{3}{4}\) possible? Give a reason.
(Kya \(\sec\theta = \frac{3}{4}\) mumkin hai? Wajah dein.)
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Is ke liye \(\cos\theta = \frac{4}{3} > 1\) chahiye; \(|\sec\theta| \ge 1\) hamesha.

book_ref.quote: Remember the shape of the answer

blocks.text: 11.1.3 Domains and Ranges of Cosecant Function

blocks.prompt:
9 Find the domain and range of \(y = \operatorname{cosec} x\).
(\(y = \operatorname{cosec} x\) ka domain aur range nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: so cosecant and cotangent have the same domain

blocks.prompt:
10 Which trigonometric functions have the same domain? Write the three pairs.
(Kin trigonometric functions ka domain aik jaisa hai? Teen jore likhein.)

book_ref.quote: The table is easy to remember in three pairs

blocks.prompt:
11 Define an even function and an odd function, with one example of each.
(Even aur odd function ki definition aik aik misaal ke saath likhein.)

book_ref.quote: A function \(f\) is said to be even if

blocks.prompt:
12 Show that \(\cos\theta\) is an even function and \(\sin\theta\) is an odd function.
(Dikhayein ke \(\cos\theta\) even aur \(\sin\theta\) odd function hai.)
blocks.explanation: Unit circle par \(-\theta\) ka point \((x, -y)\) hai. Is liye \(\cos(-\theta) = \cos\theta\) (even) aur \(\sin(-\theta) = -\sin\theta\) (odd).

book_ref.quote: So one figure proves both results

blocks.prompt:
13 Determine whether \(f(x) = x^{2}\cos x\) is even, odd or neither.
(\(f(x) = x^{2}\cos x\) even hai, odd ya dono nahi?)
blocks.explanation: \(f(-x) = x^{2}\cos x = f(x)\). Is liye even.

book_ref.quote: To decide whether a function is even, odd or neither

blocks.prompt:
14 Determine whether \(f(x) = \tan x + x^{3}\) is even, odd or neither.
(\(f(x) = \tan x + x^{3}\) even hai, odd ya dono nahi?)

book_ref.quote: Odd means: changing the sign of the input changes only the sign of the output.

blocks.prompt:
15 Determine whether \(f(x) = 1 + \sin x\) is even, odd or neither.
(\(f(x) = 1 + \sin x\) even hai, odd ya dono nahi?)
blocks.explanation: \(f(-x) = 1 - \sin x\). \(x = \frac{\pi}{2}\) par \(f = 2\) aur \(f(-x) = 0\): na \(2\) na \(-2\). Is liye na even na odd.

book_ref.quote: Most functions are neither.

blocks.prompt:
16 Show that \(\tan\theta\) is odd and \(\sec\theta\) is even.
(Dikhayein ke \(\tan\theta\) odd aur \(\sec\theta\) even hai.)

book_ref.quote: The other four functions follow from sine and cosine

blocks.prompt:
17 Define the period of a function. Write the periods of the six trigonometric functions.
(Function ke period ki definition likhein aur chhe trigonometric functions ke periods likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Agar har \(\theta\) ke liye \(f(\theta + p) = f(\theta)\) ho to sab se chhota musbat \(p\) period hai. \(\sin, \cos, \operatorname{cosec}, \sec\): \(2\pi\); \(\tan, \cot\): \(\pi\).

book_ref.quote: Period of a trigonometric function is the smallest

blocks.prompt:
18 Find the period of \(\cos 6x\).
(\(\cos 6x\) ka period nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: rewrite the shifted angle

blocks.prompt:
19 Find the period of \(\tan\frac{x}{5}\).
(\(\tan\frac{x}{5}\) ka period nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: A quick rule that follows from Example 1

blocks.prompt:
20 Find the period of \(4 - 2\sin\frac{\pi x}{3}\).
(\(4 - 2\sin\frac{\pi x}{3}\) ka period nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Constant 4 aur \(-2\) period par asar nahi karte. \(\sin\frac{\pi}{3}(x + 6) = \sin\frac{\pi x}{3}\): period \(6\).

book_ref.quote: Adding a constant does not change the period.

blocks.prompt:
21 Find the period of \(\cot(4x + 1)\).
(\(\cot(4x + 1)\) ka period nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: runs twice as fast, so the period is halved

blocks.prompt:
22 Show that \(\pi\) is not the period of \(\cos\theta\).
(Dikhayein ke \(\pi\), \(\cos\theta\) ka period nahi.)

book_ref.quote: One counter-example is enough to reject

blocks.prompt:
23 Find the values of \(\sin 240^{\circ}\) and \(\cos 150^{\circ}\).
(\(\sin 240^{\circ}\) aur \(\cos 150^{\circ}\) ki qeematein nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: where only tangent is positive

blocks.prompt:
24 Find \(\tan(-210^{\circ})\).
(\(\tan(-210^{\circ})\) nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: two minus signs make a plus

blocks.prompt:
25 Find \(\cos 315^{\circ}\) and \(\sin(-150^{\circ})\).
(\(\cos 315^{\circ}\) aur \(\sin(-150^{\circ})\) nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: The sign follows the quadrant of the angle.

blocks.prompt:
26 Find \(\sec 120^{\circ}\) and \(\operatorname{cosec} 330^{\circ}\).
(\(\sec 120^{\circ}\) aur \(\operatorname{cosec} 330^{\circ}\) nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: where only sine is positive

blocks.prompt:
27 Write the steps for drawing the graph of a trigonometric function.
(Trigonometric function ka graph banane ke qadam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (i) Ordered pairs \((x, y)\) ka table. (ii) Angles \(X\)-axis par. (iii) Qeematein \(Y\)-axis par. (iv) Points plot karein. (v) Smooth curve se milayein.

book_ref.quote: To plot the graph we shall follow these steps:

blocks.text: 11.4.2 Graph of y = sin x from - 2pi to 2pi

blocks.prompt:
28 State the maximum and minimum values of \(y = \sin x\) and where they occur.
(\(y = \sin x\) ki maximum aur minimum qeematein aur un ke maqaam batayein.)

book_ref.quote: When asked for the maximum or minimum of

blocks.prompt:
29 Where does the graph of \(y = \sin x\) cut the \(x\)-axis in \([-2\pi, 2\pi]\)?
(\([-2\pi, 2\pi]\) mein \(y = \sin x\) ka graph \(x\)-axis ko kahan kat'ta hai?)

book_ref.quote: exactly where the curve cuts the

blocks.prompt:
30 Why does the graph of \(y = \sin x\) lie between the lines \(y = 1\) and \(y = -1\)?
(\(y = \sin x\) ka graph lines \(y = 1\) aur \(y = -1\) ke darmiyan kyun rehta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kyunke har \(x\) ke liye \(-1 \le \sin x \le 1\); sine ki range \([-1, 1]\) hai.

book_ref.quote: so the graph will be between the horizontal lines

blocks.text: 11.4.3 Graph of y = cos x from - 2pi to 2pi

blocks.prompt:
31 State the maximum and minimum values and the \(x\)-intercepts of \(y = \cos x\).
(\(y = \cos x\) ki maximum, minimum qeematein aur \(x\)-intercepts batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Maximum \(1\) (\(n\) juft, \(x = n\pi\)); minimum \(-1\) (\(n\) taaq); \(x\)-intercepts \(\frac{\pi}{2} + n\pi\).

book_ref.quote: Peaks at even multiples of

blocks.prompt:
32 How is the graph of \(y = \cos x\) related to the graph of \(y = \sin x\)?
(\(y = \cos x\) ka graph \(y = \sin x\) ke graph se kaise mutaalliq hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\cos x = \sin(x + 90^{\circ})\), is liye cosine graph sine graph ko \(90^{\circ}\) baayen khiskane se milta hai.

book_ref.quote: so the cosine graph is the sine graph moved

blocks.text: 11.4.4 Graph of y = tan x from -pi to pi

blocks.prompt:
33 Write the asymptotes, the period and the \(x\)-intercepts of \(y = \tan x\) for \(-\pi \le x \le \pi\).
(\(-\pi \le x \le \pi\) ke liye \(y = \tan x\) ke asymptotes, period aur \(x\)-intercepts likhein.)

book_ref.quote: always draw the asymptotes

blocks.prompt:
34 Why is \(\tan 90^{\circ}\) undefined? What happens to \(\tan x\) just left and just right of \(90^{\circ}\)?
(\(\tan 90^{\circ}\) undefined kyun hai? \(90^{\circ}\) ke baayen aur daayen \(\tan x\) ka kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\cos 90^{\circ} = 0\), is liye undefined. Baayen \(\tan x \to +\infty\), daayen \(\tan x \to -\infty\).

book_ref.quote: dividing by a very small number gives a very large answer

blocks.text: 11.5 Maximum and Minimum Values of Given Functions of the Type a + b sin theta, a + b cos theta, a + b sin(c theta + d), a + b cos(c theta + d) and reciprocals

blocks.prompt:
35 Find the maximum and minimum values of \(7 + 2\sin 3x\).
(\(7 + 2\sin 3x\) ki maximum aur minimum qeematein nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Thus the maximum value of

blocks.prompt:
36 Find the maximum and minimum values of \(4 - 5\cos\left(x + \frac{\pi}{3}\right)\) and state when the maximum occurs.
(\(4 - 5\cos\left(x + \frac{\pi}{3}\right)\) ki maximum aur minimum qeematein nikalein aur batayein maximum kab hai.)

book_ref.quote: but the conditions printed with them hold only when

blocks.prompt:
37 Find the maximum and minimum values of \(\dfrac{1}{6 + 2\sin x}\).
(\(\dfrac{1}{6 + 2\sin x}\) ki maximum aur minimum qeematein nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: \(6 + 2\sin x\) ki qeemat \(4\) se \(8\). Maximum \(\frac{1}{4}\), minimum \(\frac{1}{8}\).

book_ref.quote: For a positive reciprocal

blocks.prompt:
38 For \(y = 3 - 4\sin\left(2x - \frac{\pi}{6}\right)\) write the midline, the amplitude, the period and the maximum and minimum values.
(\(y = 3 - 4\sin\left(2x - \frac{\pi}{6}\right)\) ki midline, amplitude, period aur maximum/minimum likhein.)

book_ref.quote: Period: the period of (i) is equal to

blocks.prompt:
39 Find the maximum and minimum values of \(2\cos\frac{x}{2} - 3\).
(\(2\cos\frac{x}{2} - 3\) ki maximum aur minimum qeematein nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: For any question of this section write three things first

blocks.prompt:
40 A Ferris wheel of radius 15 ft has its lowest point 2 ft above the ground and turns once every 30 seconds. A rider starts at the lowest point. Write a model for the height h(t).
(15 ft radius wala Ferris wheel, sab se neecha point zameen se 2 ft upar, har 30 seconds mein aik chakkar. Sawaar neeche se shuru karta hai. Height h(t) ka model likhein.)

book_ref.quote: the radius gives the amplitude

blocks.prompt:
41 The water level of a river is \(L(t) = 5 + 2\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{4}t\right)\) feet, \(t\) in hours. Find the level at \(t = 2\) and the minimum level.
(Darya ki satah \(L(t) = 5 + 2\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{4}t\right)\) feet. \(t = 2\) par satah aur kam se kam satah nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Every problem follows the same plan

blocks.prompt:
42 A quantity varies sinusoidally between a maximum of 20 m and a minimum of 4 m. Find its amplitude and midline.
(Aik miqdaar sinusoidal tor par 20 m (maximum) aur 4 m (minimum) ke darmiyan badalti hai. Amplitude aur midline nikalein.)

book_ref.quote: Model from data: amplitude
